depiction.primary_object: SIM card or SD memory card outline with clipped top-left corner
depiction.composition: single object, front view, centered modifier

readings.meaning: SIM card error, missing SIM, or SIM card alert
SD memory card error, full storage, or corrupted card
document or file warning / corrupted file

ambiguity: Without internal contact pads, the clipped-corner rectangle is identical for both a mobile SIM card and a camera SD card, and can also be mistaken for a generic file/page icon with a folded corner.

modifier_semantics.meaning: error, warning, missing, full, or needs attention

reasoning: Shows a notched card outline (standard for SIM or SD memory cards) with an exclamation point inside indicating an error, missing card, or urgent issue. It fits troubleshooting tasks for phone SIM cards and camera/device memory cards, though it can be confused with a generic file/document alert icon.
